title: RL-ATTACK: A Generalized Black-Box Adversarial Attack on Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.08711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit vulnerabilities to adversarial perturbations that can induce unintended responses. These vulnerabilities can be identified via intentional attacks and subsequently used to improve model safety. In black-box settings where gradients are inaccessible, existing methods tend to guess adversarial transformations using external knowledge, ignoring the information provided by the target model. To mitigate this, we propose a trainable black-box framework based on reinforcement learning, which learns from the target model to generate tailored adversarial transformations. We demonstrate that our approach achieves lower post-attack accuracy, greater query efficiency and better semantic preservation on both natural language inference and generative Q&A tasks. translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）存在易受对抗性扰动影响的脆弱性，这些扰动可能引发模型产生意外响应。这些脆弱性可以通过有意攻击来识别，进而用于提升模型安全性。在无法获取梯度的黑盒设置中，现有方法倾向于借助外部知识来猜测对抗性变换，忽略了目标模型所提供的信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于强化学习的可训练黑盒攻击框架，该框架通过从目标模型中学习来生成定制化的对抗性变换。我们证明，该方法在自然语言推理和生成式问答两类任务上均实现了更低的攻击后准确率、更高的查询效率以及更好的语义保持效果。在自然语言推理任务上，该方法仅需20次查询即可将攻击后准确率降至2%。针对生成式语言模型，我们训练的攻击器能够持续地（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了RL-ATTACK，一种基于强化学习的可训练黑盒对抗攻击框架，通过从目标模型学习生成定制化对抗变换，在自然语言推理和生成式问答任务上均实现了更低的攻击后准确率、更高的查询效率和更好的语义保持。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RL-ATTACK, a trainable reinforcement learning-based black-box adversarial attack framework that learns from the target model to generate tailored adversarial transformations, achieving lower post-attack accuracy, greater query efficiency, and better semantic preservation on both natural language inference and generative Q&A tasks.
